rules.text: Do not use "please" as a courtesy filler in instructions or task-oriented copy. Start with the action verb when possible. If simply removing "please" leaves awkward wording, rewrite the sentence while preserving meaning.
Use direct imperative wording for task instructions. Lead with the action users need to take and avoid unnecessary introductory phrases.
Use plain, concise language. Prefer familiar words and short sentences when meaning and required detail are preserved.

Preserve legal, eligibility, deadline, service, and policy meaning. Do not simplify content in a way that changes who qualifies, what action is required, when something happens, or what a service provides.

examples.avoid: Please note that processing times may vary.
If you need help, please contact us.
examples.prefer: If you need help, contact us.

examples.avoid: Please ensure your information is accurate.
examples.prefer: Make sure your information is accurate.

examples.avoid: You may want to review your information before submitting.
It is important that you keep a copy for your records.
examples.prefer: Keep a copy for your records.

examples.avoid: Prior to submitting your application, verify that all required fields have been completed.
examples.prefer: Before you submit your application, make sure you have completed all required fields.

examples.avoid: Individuals experiencing difficulty accessing their account may contact us for assistance.
examples.prefer: If you cannot access your account, contact us for help.

examples.avoid: Apply by June 30 to keep receiving payments.
examples.prefer: Apply by June 30 to keep receiving payments.

examples.avoid: You must be 18 years of age or older and live in Canada to apply.
examples.prefer: You must be 18 years of age or older and live in Canada to apply.
